summary: Adult female fell on the Crater Lake trail ~1/2 mile from Maroon Lake and injured her ankle, unable to walk. Pitkin deputies and Aspen Volunteer Fire responded; ankle immobilized; patient carried down by Stokes litter to a waiting ambulance. Posted by MRA.
location: Crater Lake Trail, ~1/2 mi from Maroon Lake, Maroon Bells Wilderness
notes: Carry-out performed by Aspen Volunteer Fire; posted by MRA as a team page release.
